meta.notes: Not a sidekick, and he does not validate her. He came with wrapping paper. No jokes and no companion reply in this thread. Pictures are never clue rewards.

threads.topic: Can I help you with those?

choices.label: The paper said she lodged at the Orison.

ev_1s.line: He puts the pin carefully back in its hole and does not begin.

ev_2.line: Mind the corner. No, you've got it. She did that one the winter the pipes froze. Don't look at it, it isn't for looking at, it's for the wall.

ev_3.line: Over this shop. Eleven years. Her rent book is in the drawer the thief didn't want. I don't know who told them lodged. Nobody told me anything, I had it from the paper too.

ev_3s.line: These can come home. I've said that. I'll just do this one.
